Class GameState

java.lang.Object
org.openjfx.model.GameState
All Implemented Interfaces:
Serializable
public class GameState extends Object implements Serializable
Contains the current state of an ongoing match.
It remembers the players, their position and the direction of the match (clockwise or not).
It also initializes the deck, shuffles it, tracks its lifecycle with the discard pile (which can be turned into a new deck) and manages any interaction with the deck.
The statistics of the match are registered by MatchStats

    • initDrawPile

      public void initDrawPile()
      Builds a pile of cards following the standard Uno-style card deck.
      Therefore, the deck contains:
      • 76 Number cards (of all colors; one '0' and two of each from '1' to '9' per color).
      • 24 Action cards (two Skip, two Reverse, and two Draw Two per color).
      • 8 Wild cards.
      The deck is then shuffled and ready to use.
